extract: Virginia Ann Foxx is an American politician and educator who served as the U.S. representative for North Carolina's 5th congressional district from 2005 until her defeat in the 2026 midterm election. A member of the Republican Party, Foxx served as chair of the House Rules Committee in the 119th Congress.
